-- Spec: look up `key` in `name=value` per-line config text.
-- Absent key yields "". Pure: no capabilities declared.

config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  pre key.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() <= text.char_count()
  ex config_value("host=local\nport=80", "port") == "80"
  ex config_value("host=local", "missing") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    let parts = line.split("=")
    if parts[0] == key
      var v = ""
      var i = 0
      for p in parts
        if i == 1
          v = copy p
        else if i > 1
          v = v + "=" + p
        i += 1
      return v
  ""
